title: Multilevel Preconditioning Strategies for Convex Optimization Methods in Image Deblurring
summary: Proximal gradient methods are widely used in imaging, and their speed of convergence can be accelerated by incorporating variable metrics and/or extrapolation steps. Recent works have shown that preconditioning strategies can significantly enhance this acceleration, in particular, for image deblurring problems. In parallel, a multilevel framework has been introduced to speed up inertial and inexact forward-backward schemes for image restoration problems.
